# Validation fixtures

Generated by the oracles in `scripts/validation/`. Do not edit by hand; every
file has a deterministic generator and a Rust consumer in
`tests/cross_validation.rs`.

| Fixture | Ficha | Oracle | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gasteiger_rdkit.json` | F21 | `oracle_rdkit.py charges` | RDKit Gasteiger charges (nIter=6) for 259 molecules |
| `parse_rdkit.json` | F01 | `oracle_rdkit.py parse` | composition, heavy-atom bond orders (unsanitized), formal charges, hybridizations |
| `sssr_rdkit.json` | F05 | `oracle_rdkit.py sssr` | strict SSSR (Figueras) ring-size multisets |
| `sasa_rdkit.json` | F28 | `oracle_rdkit.py sasa` | FreeSASA Shrake-Rupley areas with sci-form's radii table |
| `uff_opt.json` | F70 | `oracle_uffopt.py` | RDKit UFF-opt (ETKDG seed 42 → `UFFOptimizeMolecule`): geometrías inicial/final + E (10 moléculas) |
| `uff_rdkit.json` | F16 | `oracle_rdkit.py uff` | RDKit UFF energies on fixture geometries (398 cases; 2 Kekulé inputs skipped, see `skipped_aromaticity_reperception`) |
| `uff_labels_rdkit.json` | F17 | `oracle_rdkit.py labels` | RDKit `getAtomLabel` UFF types (298 molecules, 33 641 labels) |
| `pyscf_scf.json` | F36/F37/F23/F26 | `oracle_pyscf.py` | PySCF RHF/STO-3G: S/T/V, ERIs (4 molecules/13 074), E_tot, MO energies, Mulliken (11 molecules) |
| `pyscf_uhf.json` | F38 | `oracle_pyscf.py uhf` | PySCF UHF/ROHF: E_tot y ⟨S²⟩ con conjetura `hcore` y por defecto (8 casos abiertos) |
| `pyscf_ao2mo.json` | F39 | `oracle_pyscf.py ao2mo` | PySCF `ao2mo.full`: C, ERIs AO y MO (3 moléculas/13 058 MO ERIs) |
| `tblite_gfn.json` | F44/F45 | `oracle_tblite.py` | tblite GFN1/GFN2-xTB: E, HOMO/LUMO (18 moléculas, geometrías ETKDG+MMFF) |
| `dftd4_dispersion.json` | F46 | `oracle_dftd4.py` | dftd4 PBE (D4) y s-dftd3 con parámetros HF-3c (18 moléculas) |

| `xtb_gfn0.json` | F43 | `oracle_xtb.py` (XTB=…) | xtb 6.7.1 `--gfn 0 --sp`: E, HOMO/LUMO (18 moléculas) |

## Regenerate

```bash
python scripts/validation/oracle_rdkit.py all
```

Tool versions used for the checked-in fixtures are recorded in
`validation/refs.lock.json` (repo root). The oracles require RDKit and
FreeSASA; the Rust tests only need the JSON fixtures.

F49 additionally reads `tests/fixtures/experimental_reference.json`
(NIST/CCCBDB experimental IR bands, checked in; shared with other suites).
